{"code": "import pandas as pd

def note_finding(message, implication=None):
    print(f"[FINDING] {message}")
    if implication:
        print(f"[IMPLICATION] {implication}")

# Check for sentinel values
if (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).any():
    note_finding("Biomarker baseline has sentinel value -999", 
                 "This may indicate missing or invalid data, which could bias analysis if not handled.")

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
if trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().any():
    note_finding("Duplicate patient_id found", 
                 "This could indicate data entry errors or repeated measurements, violating independence.")

# Check for missing values
if trial_df.isnull().any().any():
    note_finding("Missing values detected", 
                 "This could bias estimates if missingness is not random.")

# Check if response rate varies by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Check if sex is balanced across arms
sex_by_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm'])
print("\nSex distribution by arm:")
print(sex_by_arm)

# Check if sex is balanced across severity
sex_by_severity = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])
print("\nSex distribution by severity:")
print(sex_by_severity)"}
